nl: Make the orders service restart always instead of only on failure (etc/systemd/system/orders.service).

etc/systemd/system/orders.service.text:
[Unit]
Description=Orders service
After=network.target

[Service]
User=orders
ExecStart=/opt/orders/bin/orders --port 8080
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('etc/systemd/system/orders.service'); t = p.read_text()
assert t.count('Restart=on-failure') == 1
p.write_text(t.replace('Restart=on-failure', 'Restart=always'))
EOF
